t: The first state to leave the Central American federation, in 1838, long torn between liberal León and conservative Granada.
Its possible canal route drew British, filibuster and American interventions, from William Walker in 1856 to US Marines in 1912–1933.
The Somoza dynasty ruled from 1936 to 1979 until the Sandinista revolution; Daniel Ortega has governed again since 2007.
dyk: In 1902 opponents of a Nicaraguan canal sent US senators Nicaraguan postage stamps showing Momotombo volcano in eruption; shortly afterwards the Senate chose Panama.
ev: Nicaragua becomes the first state to leave the Federal Republic of Central America
Managua is chosen as a compromise capital between León and Granada
The American filibuster William Walker makes himself president
José Santos Zelaya incorporates the Mosquito Reserve
US Marines land, beginning an occupation that lasts until 1933
Augusto César Sandino is murdered on the orders of Anastasio Somoza García
The Sandinista revolution overthrows Anastasio Somoza Debayle
Violeta Barrios de Chamorro defeats Daniel Ortega, ending the Contra war
